description: A series of coordinated ransomware attacks on regional healthcare networks in Germany, France, and Belgium—each using AI-generated exploit chains tailored to legacy systems—leads to a temporary shutdown of non-emergency services. The attacks are not the most sophisticated, but their timing and targeting suggest a new level of automation and coordination. Attribution is unclear, but forensic analysis points to a non-state actor using a model-assisted framework. The incident underscores the gap between offensive capability and defensive readiness.
